# 150ct

> Free, no sign-up web tools for getting together. Each tool does one job, works from a single shareable link, and deletes itself after the event. No accounts, no ads, no app.

## Tools

- [Potluck](https://150ct.com/potluck): Free potluck sign-up sheet. Make a list of dishes, send one link, and guests claim what they're bringing so nothing is doubled. No sign-up or app.
- [When works](https://150ct.com/meet): Free group scheduling poll. Pick some days or hours, send one link, everyone taps when they're free, and the best day shows up. No sign-up or app.
- [Where to eat](https://150ct.com/eat): Free tool to pick a few restaurants and send your group one text with the Google Maps links. No sign-up or app.
- [Gift exchange](https://150ct.com/gift): Free Secret Santa name drawer. Type everyone's name, names are drawn right away, and each person taps their own name to see who they're buying for. Nobody else sees the pairs, not even the organizer.
- [Registry](https://150ct.com/registry): Free gift registry from any store. Paste links from Amazon, Target, Etsy or anywhere, send one link, and guests tap the gift they'll get so nothing is bought twice. Optional surprise mode hides what's been claimed from the host.
- [To Grams](https://150ct.com/grams): Free cups to grams converter for baking. Pick an ingredient once, see grams for every common cup and spoon amount, and tap to build a whole recipe list. No typing or sign-up. Dry goods use the King Arthur Baking weight chart, liquids use USDA cup weights.

## How it works

- The host makes a link and sends it to the group chat. Guests open it in any browser; nobody signs up.
- Links are deleted automatically, generally 30 days after the event.
- Gift exchange: names are drawn when the link is made. Each person sees only who they're buying for. The organizer can see who has looked, never who has who.
- Registry: other guests see a gift as taken, never who took it. The host sees who's getting what, unless surprise is on.

## Use from AI apps

- MCP server: https://150ct.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP, no sign-in). Tools make potluck sheets, date polls, gift exchanges and registries, and convert cups to grams. Each returns a link for the group and a private host link.

## Comparisons

- [150ct vs Elfster for Secret Santa](https://150ct.com/compare/elfster): Comparing 150ct and Elfster for drawing Secret Santa names. 150ct needs no accounts or emails and nobody sees the pairs. Elfster is built around wishlists and shopping.
- [A When2meet alternative that's easy on a phone](https://150ct.com/compare/when2meet): Looking for a When2meet alternative? 150ct's When works is free with no sign up, made for tapping on a phone, and shows the best day at the top.
- [A SignUpGenius alternative for potlucks](https://150ct.com/compare/signupgenius): A simpler SignUpGenius alternative for potlucks. 150ct is free with no ads and no accounts for the host or guests. Guests claim a dish so nothing doubles up.
- [150ct vs DrawNames for Secret Santa](https://150ct.com/compare/drawnames): Comparing 150ct and DrawNames for drawing Secret Santa names. Both are free. DrawNames adds wishlists and an app. 150ct is one link with no emails, and nobody sees the pairs.
- [150ct vs Doodle for picking a date with friends](https://150ct.com/compare/doodle): A free Doodle alternative for friends and family. 150ct's When works needs no account to make a poll, has no ads, and shows the best day at the top. Doodle is better for work calendars.
- [150ct vs PerfectPotluck](https://150ct.com/compare/perfectpotluck): Comparing 150ct and PerfectPotluck for potluck sign ups. Both are free with no accounts. PerfectPotluck sends email reminders. 150ct guests just tap a dish from the group chat, no email.
- [Free Secret Santa generators compared](https://150ct.com/compare/secret-santa-generators): Elfster, DrawNames, Secret Santa Organizer and 150ct compared. All draw names for free. Here's which one fits a group chat, a wishlist crowd, or an email list.
- [Free group scheduling polls compared](https://150ct.com/compare/group-scheduling-polls): When2meet, Doodle, Rallly, Crab Fit and 150ct compared for finding a time that works. Which free scheduling poll fits friends on phones, work meetings, or precise time slots.
- [Free potluck sign up sheets compared](https://150ct.com/compare/potluck-sign-up-sheets): SignUpGenius, PerfectPotluck, SignUp.com, a Google Sheet and 150ct compared for potlucks. Which free sign up sheet keeps dishes from doubling up with the least hassle.
- [Free gift registries for any store compared](https://150ct.com/compare/gift-registry-any-store): Amazon, Babylist, MyRegistry and 150ct compared for a gift list from any store. Which free registry fits a baby shower, a wedding, a birthday, or a quick list with no account.
